title: Dealer visits and recommended fixes
summary: Reviews center on service writers recommending next steps such as dealer visits, software updates, installation help, cleaning advice, and charging setup, with sentiment often depending on whether the recommendation is presented as helpful or simply noted.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe helpful recommendations including dealer follow-up, second opinions, software restart steps, cleaning guidance, charging outlet installation, pricing guidance, and praise for cloth seats.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback appears where the writer recommends mentioning an issue to service during another visit, suggesting help but alongside unresolved problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly note suggested dealer visits, upgrade advice, installation assistance, or delayed iOS updating without enough context to judge the experience.

limitations: This topic mixes several unrelated subjects, including dealer visits, software and iOS updates, charging installation, cleaning advice, and seat material comments.
Many fragments are brief procedural notes without enough context to determine whether the recommendation solved a problem or improved satisfaction.
Examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions beyond these specific fragments.
